stories.headline: Ex-Fed nominee Shelton tapped to advise Treasury's Bessent
stories.body: The Department of the Treasury has picked Judy Shelton, an economist and former nominee for the Federal Reserve Board, to be a counselor in Secretary Scott Bessent's office.
